map.小剂量（1 mg 过夜或 2 mg×48h）后皮质醇不被抑制提示 Cushing: After a low dose (1 mg overnight or 2 mg x 48h), failure of cortisol to be suppressed suggests Cushing; however depression, obesity and drugs can cause false positives, so repeat and combine tests.

map.正常皮质醇晨高夜低，节律消失是 Cushing 的重要线索；午夜唾液/血清皮质醇: Normal cortisol is high in the morning and low at night; a lost rhythm is an important clue for Cushing, and midnight salivary or serum cortisol is a sensitive screening test.
